title: The Kobayashi-Hitchin correspondence for nef and big classes
summary: In this paper, we establish the Kobayashi-Hitchin correspondence for nef and big cohomology classes by introducing the notions of adapted closed positive $(1,1)$-currents and adapted Hermitian-Yang-Mills metrics. As applications, we investigate the equality cases of both the Bogomolov-Gieseker inequality for semistable reflexive sheaves with respect to big classes admitting a bimeromorphic Zariski decomposition and the Miyaoka-Yau inequality for projective varieties with big anti-canonical divisor.
